image.name: craft-apps
image.description: [ArtCraft](https://getartcraft.com/) is a suite of open source creative applications written in Rust. This image bundles PhotoCraft (image editor), VectorCraft (vector illustration), FilmCraft (video editor), LightCraft (photo library and raw developer), PdfCraft (PDF workbench), EffectCraft (motion graphics and VFX compositor), DesignCraft (page layout and publishing) and FigCraft (interface design and prototyping) in a single desktop.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: HTTP Craft Apps desktop gui, must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is needed for the applications and websites to function properly.

image.title: Craft-apps
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  craft-apps:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/craft-apps:latest
    container_name: craft-apps
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/craft-apps/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=craft-apps \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/craft-apps/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/craft-apps:latest
